newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FHTK projects FY97 net profit at S$10.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: FHTK projects FY97 net profit at S$10.9 mln.

text.p: FHTK Holdings Ltd said on Friday it projected net profit of Singapore $10.9 million for financial year 1997, a 36.25 percent increase from fiscal 1996.
"The group expects turnover of S$236.7 million, a 63 percent growth over 1996," said Soon Soon Beng, group financial controller of FHTK during its initial public offer briefing.
He said the group expects a profit before tax of S$14.9 million, an increase of 39 percent from 1996.
He said turnover and profit are expected to pick up in the second half of fiscal year 1997 due to the seasonal China produce harvest period and festivities.
For the six months ended September 30 1996, FHTK recorded a net profit of S$1.08 million on a turnover of S$80.6 million.
Soon said the group had added bananas to its fruit products and this is expected to contribute significantly to financial year 1997.
The company had also started planting garlic and expects to produce one third of its own garlic output in China, officials said.
